# Icon Setup Instructions

## Current Status

- **public/logo.png** – Canonical mark for the vendor UI and browser; copied to `assets/logo.png` when you run `npm run setup:icons`
- **logo.ico** – Generated from `assets/logo.png`; used by Electron Windows and web `favicon.ico`
- **Square web icons** – `public/icon-192.png`, `public/icon-512.png`, `public/apple-touch-icon.png` generated by `setup:icons` from the same source
- **build/icon.ico** – Copied from `assets/logo.ico` by `setup:icons`; electron-builder uses this for the **installed** exe, Desktop shortcut, and Start Menu

## Required Icon Formats

### Windows (.ico)
- **Generated**: `npm run setup:icons` (writes `assets/logo.ico` and `public/favicon.ico`)
- **Location**: `apps/vendor/assets/logo.ico`
- **Source**: `apps/vendor/public/logo.png` is synced to `assets/logo.png` at the start of `setup:icons` so Electron matches the browser

### Web (tab, PWA)
- Run `npm run setup:icons` after changing `public/logo.png` to refresh `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, and `favicon.ico`
- Bump the service worker cache names in `public/sw.js` only if you must force clients to refetch icons without a full cache clear

### macOS (.icns)
- **Required**: `logo.icns`
- **Location**: `apps/vendor/assets/logo.icns`

### Linux (.png)
- **Source**: `logo.png` (same file used for tray and web)
- **Location**: `apps/vendor/assets/logo.png`

## Conversion Tools

### Option 1: Online converter (easiest for logo.ico)
1. Visit https://convertio.co/png-ico/ or https://cloudconvert.com/png-to-ico
2. Upload `public/logo.png` (or `assets/logo.png` after sync)
3. Download as `logo.ico`
4. Save to `apps/vendor/assets/logo.ico`, then run `npm run setup:icons` to copy `build/icon.ico` and refresh web favicons

### Option 2: ImageMagick
```bash
magick convert logo.png -define icon:auto-resize=16,32,48,64,128,256 logo.ico
```

### Option 3: npm script (if png-to-ico works)
```bash
cd apps/vendor && npm run setup:icons
```

## Verification

```bash
# Windows build needs logo.ico and logo.png
dir apps\vendor\assets\
# Should have: logo.png, logo.ico (and optionally logo.icns for macOS)
```

## Notes
- **Wide logos**: `setup:icons` pads with the dashboard background color (#121b26) when generating square PWA icons
- Transparent `public/logo.png` works well for the in-app topbar; square marks look best on the Windows taskbar
- Recommended source size: 512×512 pixels or larger when possible
- The Windows icon will appear in:
  - Windows taskbar
  - App window title bar
  - Installer
  - Desktop shortcut and Start Menu (when using `build/icon.ico` via `npm run setup:icons` before build)
